Stephanie / Marcus — I dug into the stack trace Alex attached and reproduced the issue in our staging harness. Short summary: the connector's token-exchange flow fails for a subset of refresh tokens used by Novapay's sandbox users due to an unexpected header transformation in their proxy. The fix is straightforward (update header mapping + add a retry on 401), but it requires a small deploy + QA run. ETA: ~7–9 business days if we prioritize it this sprint; could slip to 10–12 if it hits other priorities.

Impact: until fixed, the POC's automated test runs will continue to fail, so traffic will be low. I recommend approving a 10–14 day sandbox window extension and a partial token top-up (40k) to cover validation runs once the deploy goes out.
